2609.11452.title: RouteRepair: Instance-Level Failure Diagnosis and Targeted Repair in LLM-Based Automated Heuristic Design for Routing Optimization
2609.11452.paper_summary: Efficient routing optimization is essential to freight transportation, urban logistics, and shared mobility, where high-quality heuristics are often required under limited computational budgets. Recent large language model (LLM)-based automated heuristic design methods can generate effective routing rules, but aggregate evaluation may mask recurrent failures on particular instance structures. To address this limitation, this study develops RouteRepair, which diagnoses parent-specific weaknesses from instance-level performance and applies targeted modifications to the corresponding heuristic components while protecting behavior that already performs well. Routing evidence, solver behavior, and program context are combined to define bounded repair objectives, and each intervention is validated through matched parent-child evaluation of failure recovery and collateral degradation. Experiments on the traveling salesman problem (TSP) and capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) span constructive search, guided local search, and ant colony optimization. RouteRepair-GLS reduces the mean TSP optimality gap from 1.7476% to 0.7587%, while the constructive CVRP heuristic lowers average route cost by 1.91% relative to the savings heuristic; the generated ACO priors also outperform matched hand-designed priors. These results show that failure-aware, evidence-constrained refinement can improve routing heuristics on difficult instances while preserving performance on cases they already solve well.
2609.11452.paper_summary_zh: 有效的路由優化對於貨運運輸、城市物流和共享移動至關重要，這些領域通常需要在有限的計算預算下使用高品質的啟發式方法。最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的自動啟發式設計方法能夠生成有效的路由規則，但綜合評估可能掩蓋特定實例結構上的反復失敗。為了解決這一限制，本研究開發了RouteRepair，它從實例級性能診斷特定父母的弱點，並對相應的啟發式組件進行針對性修改，同時保護已經表現良好的行為。路由證據、求解器行為和程序上下文被結合起來定義有界修復目標，每次干預都通過匹配的父子評估來驗證失敗恢復和附帶退化。在旅行推銷員問題（TSP）和有容量的車輛路由問題（CVRP）上的實驗涵蓋了建設性搜索、引導局部搜索和螞蟻群優化。RouteRepair-GLS將TSP的平均最優性差距從1.7476%降低到0.7587%，而建設性的CVRP啟發式方法相對於節省啟發式方法降低了平均路徑成本1.91%；生成的ACO先驗也超越了匹配的手工設計先驗。這些結果表明，關注失敗的、受證據約束的精煉可以在困難實例上改善路由啟發式，同時保持它們在已經解決良好的案例上的性能。
